note: circuits-com is a private Vite app, not a bundlable component library (no main/module/exports, no Storybook, components coupled to react-router + useAuth + adminApi). The converter path (package-build.mjs) has no library entry point to compile. The Claude Design project is likewise hand-authored (ui_kits/ + preview/*.html), not the skill's components/<group>/<Name>/ layout. Syncs are therefore authored preview cards written in place, following the project's own conventions.
